title: Tip from Angela - Set Your Expectations
summary: A short motivational tip about realistic expectations: coding is neither trivial nor reserved for geniuses, and progress comes from accumulated practice.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Claims that programming is easy apply only to the first basics; real mastery takes sustained effort.
Finding it difficult is normal and says nothing about ability.
The opposite myth, that only exceptional people can learn it, is also false.
Working developers differ from learners mainly in hours of practice, so more work leads to better results.
Take the middle view: it is hard but achievable, so keep going.

pitfalls: Reading difficulty as a sign you are not suited to coding.
